name: android-usb-runner
description: Build and run your Android app on a USB-connected phone with one click.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Deploying executes the project's Gradle Wrapper and requires a trusted workspace.

virtualWorkspaces.description: Android USB Runner needs local Windows project files and USB access.

androidUsbRunner.adbPath.description: Absolute path to adb.exe. Overrides automatic ADB discovery. Windows %ENVIRONMENT_VARIABLES% are supported.

androidUsbRunner.androidSdkPath.description: Optional Android SDK directory. Supplies platform-tools/adb.exe and build-tools/aapt2.exe. Overrides automatically discovered SDK locations.

androidUsbRunner.javaHome.description: Optional JDK/JBR home directory (containing bin/java.exe). Overrides Java for this extension's Gradle process only.

androidUsbRunner.gradleTask.description: One assemble task, e.g. assembleDebug or assembleDemoDebug. An unqualified task is scoped to the selected app module. A qualified task must belong to that module. Shell arguments are not accepted.

scripts.vscode:prepublish: npm run check:details && npm run compile
scripts.test: npm run compile && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node --test out-test/test/*.test.js
scripts.test:host: npm run compile && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node out-test/test/runHost.js
